title: Swarm: grant + revoke a Consul ACL token (protected refusal)
description: Runs `nexus acl swarm grant --user demo` (creates consul:nexus-acl-demo with builtin/dns), then `revoke --user nexus-acl-demo`, then proves a protected token cannot be revoked.

observe.what: a new consul token nexus-acl-demo is created with the builtin/dns policy
the demo token is deleted; the post-revoke list no longer shows it
the bootstrap token revoke is refused (cluster/operator identity)

whatProves: SwarmAdapter.AclAsync(grant/revoke) creates a Consul token with the minimal builtin/dns policy and deletes by accessor; bootstrap/agent/management tokens are protected.
